subject: *: stop writing analyze v1 stats (#66772)
summary: Removes the analyze v1 write path and standardizes ANALYZE/auto-analyze on stats version 2: planner no longer builds v1-specific tasks, executor always runs the v2 full-sampling pipeline, restricted SQL exec drops the v1 option, and auto-analyze logs when it is rewriting legacy v1 stats to v2. Session/system-variable and upgrade logic are updated to disallow `tidb_analyze_version=1` and initialize missing values to 2.
